motion.name: scroll-linked
motion.purpose: Disassembly follows document scroll; explicit buttons work without motion.

components.name: Motion button
components.description: Pause or resume the scroll interaction.

components.name: Layer rail
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;gap:24px;border-top:1px solid #303741}.ds-rail button{background:none;color:#aab4c3;border:0;border-top:1px solid transparent;padding:19px 0 10px;font:11px sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-rail button[aria-pressed=true]{color:#d6e8fc;border-color:#a2c9f3}.ds-rail button:hover{color:white}.ds-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a2c9f3;outline-offset:6px}

narrative.overview: An object in a black studio, revealed with precision. The interface stays quiet so the moving mechanical architecture owns the experience.
dos: Do keep the object visible before any animation begins.
Do keep imagery synthetic and clearly disclosed.
Do use a single scroll-linked motion grammar.
donts: Don't add commercial performance claims to this fictional watch.
Don't hide content behind entrance animations.
